import { spec, specId, verifies } from "@libar-dev/software-delivery-protocol";

export const exampleRoundTripSpec = spec({
  id: specId("spec:round-trip.example"),
  title: "Accept a positive order",
  kind: "example",
  altitude: "story",
  readiness: "ready",
  relations: [verifies(specId("spec:round-trip.behavior"))],
  intent: {
    description: "A verifier needs one executable order scenario.",
  },
  behavior: {
    examples: [
      {
        given: ["an order has a positive total"],
        when: ["the order is submitted"],
        "th\u0065n": ["the order is accepted"],
      },
    ],
  },
});
